topics.summary: Iran attacked US targets in Bahrain, prompting US retaliation and escalating regional tensions.
European leaders expressed concern over potential secret discussions between Trump, Xi, and Putin in China.
A gas geyser at an LA landfill caused a public health emergency due to noxious odors and trash.
Nvidia reported strong Q3 earnings with 103% revenue growth, but its board will not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella expressed strong belief in Artificial General Intelligence's imminent arrival.
Projections for the 12-team College Football Playoff bracket were released ahead of Week 12 games.

items.joke:
Four engineers get into a car. The car won't start.
The Mechanical engineer says "It's a broken starter".
The Electrical engineer says "Dead battery".
The Chemical engineer says "Impurities in the gasoline".
The IT engineer says "Hey guys, I have an idea: How about we all get out of the car and get back in".
"We messed up the keming again guys."

idiom.title: Throw a monkey wrench into the works
idiom.interpretationEn: This phrase originates from a real tool in American industrial history, the “monkey wrench.” If the tool was thrown into a working machine, it would cause the machine to stop or be damaged. Consequently, this phrase metaphorically evolved to describe any action that disrupts or sabotages plans or ongoing processes, whether intentionally or accidentally.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个短语起源于美国工业历史中的一个真实工具，即 “猴子扳手（monkey wrench）”。如果把这个工具扔进运转的机器里，势必会导致机器停工或损坏。因此，这个表达逐渐演变为比喻任何故意或无意中破坏已经计划好或正在进行的事情的行为。

examples.en: His sudden resignation really threw a monkey wrench into the works of our project.
examples.zh: 他的突然辞职真是我么项目里的大搅局。

examples.en: The bad weather threw a monkey wrench into the works of our outdoor event schedules.
examples.zh: 恶劣天气破坏了我们户外活动的安排。

examples.en: Technical issues threw a monkey wrench into the works of the live broadcast.
examples.zh: 技术问题让直播出了乱子。

people.name: Amanda Lear
people.extract: Amanda Lear is a French singer, songwriter, painter, television presenter, actress and former model.

people.name: Lamoral, Count of Egmont
people.extract: Lamoral, Count of Egmont, Prince of Gavere was a general and statesman in the Spanish Netherlands just before the start of the Eighty Years' War, whose execution helped spark the national uprising that eventually led to the independence of the Netherlands.
highlights: General and statesman in Spanish Netherlands
Led to independence of the Netherlands

people.name: Trent Barrett
people.bio: Australian RL coach and former Australia international rugby league footballer
people.extract: Trent Barrett is an Australian professional rugby league football coach who is currently the assistant coach of the Brisbane Broncos and a former professional rugby league footballer who played in the 1990s, 2000s and 2010s.
highlights: Assistant coach of the Brisbane Broncos
